title: Tilde commutes with the unbounded total tensor complex
statement: For a commutative ring A and arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes P and N of A-modules, localization Q [def-pc-derived-category] of the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of their termwise tilde sheaves on Spec(A) is naturally isomorphic, in both factors, to Q of the termwise tilde of the total module tensor complex. No K-flatness is required. Tilde is the associated-sheaf functor [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections].

source.place: Tag 08DX, lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, proof of (2); termwise tensor comparison Tag 01I8

proof.text:
the affine tilde tensor comparison of Tag 01I8 identifies, in each bidegree,
`tilde(P.X p) tensor tilde(N.X q)` with `tilde(P.X p tensor N.X q)`. Its uniqueness
on pure global tensors implies naturality in both factors. Consequently it respects
both differentials, including the sign on the second differential. The tilde functor
is a left adjoint to global sections, and therefore preserves every coproduct indexed
by the pairs (p,q) with p+q=n, even when the complexes are unbounded. Apply these
coproduct comparisons degreewise to obtain mutually inverse chain maps. Checking on
each summand gives naturality with respect to maps of both input complexes. Apply Q to the natural chain isomorphism to obtain the localized statement.
